title: Taylor impact benchmark (UL × JC viscoplastic × reduced Hex8 + hourglass)
objective: Run the Taylor impact benchmark: a cylindrical bar strikes a rigid wall. UL formulation + Johnson-Cook viscoplasticity + reduced Hex8 with Flanagan-Belytschko hourglass control + explicit dynamics. Reproduce the final deformed shape and plastic strain distribution from Johnson & Cook literature within 5%.

plan_assets.asset_description: B9.2 Taylor impact row + Plan B overall acceptance test.

scope: Build the Taylor bar mesh: cylindrical bar, axial symmetry, reduced Hex8.
Run with UL + JC + hourglass control + explicit central difference.
Extract final deformed shape (length, mushroom diameter) and PEEQ field.
Compare to Johnson & Cook (1983) experimental + simulation data within 5%.
implementation_steps: Apply impact BCs: rigid floor via penalty or node-constraint.
Extract final geometry and plastic strain.
acceptance_criteria: Final bar length within 5% of reference.
risks: This test combines Phase 1 (UL) + Phase 3 (JC) + Phase 5 (reduced Hex8 + hourglass) + Phase 7 (explicit). Any bug in any of these will surface here and be hard to localize. Mitigation: run each of the underlying unit tests first and only then enable this benchmark.
Rigid-wall contact is a new capability. Mitigation: use a node-by-node penalty method in a single direction (y = 0) rather than full contact detection.

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_taylor_impact.py -v -m "nightly or regression or integration"

implementation_branch: ph10_preq (work/phase10-e8-public-taylor-benchmark) merged to main via PR #122
completion_notes: Delivered via ph10_preq sub-plan Phase 8 (E8 Public Taylor Benchmark). PLAN-B closure 2026-04-26 on SOSOVSKI/plan-b-ph10-exec.

Reference path is Path A (frozen-reference regression against a calibrated steel-like JC profile, see module docstring). Literature OFHC copper match (Johnson & Cook 1985) was infeasible at the shipped runtime budget — recorded as a carry-forward in ph10_preq Plan_Completion_Summary.md.
Acceptance criteria met against the frozen baseline: final length within 5%, mushroom diameter within 5%, peak PEEQ within 10%.
